title: Cannot-tell status recovery loses selected project root
symptom: Printed status rerun from the project parent cannot find the change
trigger: Run all printed recovery commands after specsync --root selects a nested project
expected: Status retries the same selected project and names the upstream archive
actual: At 23fffcedee001dac6ede47e89ffe912b819b4552 the final printed command exited 1: change not found
impact: A user recovering from unreadable upstream archives cannot finish the advertised recovery from the original directory
source: PR #967 round-2 P1 executable recovery regression

notes.text: status: open -> verified. The executable regression now runs the printed status command against the selected root from the repository parent; all 9 focused unit/command and 4 integration tests passed in t1b2. No native approval/review or second archive was written.
